races.paceDynamic: Qarreeb will lead from the gates with only Lighting Thunder and Midsummer Storm positioned prominently behind him, creating a manageable tempo over this extended trip. The confirmed front runner won't face early pressure, allowing him to dictate fractions that suit his stamina profile on this flat course. With two unknowns in Flag Of Eva and Forever Endless potentially tracking from midfield, and hold-up horse Romanticizing needing the pace to collapse, this sets up as a true staying test. This race shape strongly favours the front running and prominent racers who can control their own destiny over the trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Qarreeb maintains an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear in the straight while prominent tracker Lighting Thunder gives chase from an ideal position. Both avoid traffic problems and stamina tells over speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Lighting Thunder or Midsummer Storm apply early pressure to Qarreeb
scenarios.body: The pace quickens beyond the leader's comfort zone, allowing the stronger prominent racer to take over approaching the turn. Superior class and trainer form gives the edge to the Gosden runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Flag Of Eva or Forever Endless possess hidden ability from their light campaigns
scenarios.body: Either newcomer settles well in behind before unleashing superior raw talent in the final furlong. Fresh legs and potential untapped ability overcome more exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Style Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong between Qarreeb and prominent challengers
scenarios.body: Romanticizing gets the perfect setup from the rear as the leaders tire, with Haggas' patient tactics paying dividends. The Newmarket runner times his challenge to perfection.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Lighting Thunder or Midsummer Storm press Qarreeb early, as sustained pressure could set up the race for closers
Monitor how quickly Flag Of Eva and Forever Endless break from the gates, as unknown running styles could disrupt pace calculations
Observe Romanticizing's early positioning - if tracking closer than usual, it suggests connections expect stronger early pace
Watch for any market moves on the two lightly raced runners, as connections may know more about their true ability
Note if Qarreeb shows early pace keenness, as any fighting for position would compromise his stamina advantage

races.paceDynamic: Inferno will take them along as the sole front runner, setting a moderate pace that won't be pressured early with Valkyrie Storm and Gwen's Girl likely tracking just behind. The majority of the field (Sailor Batt, Bosom Pals, Empirical, Quick Turn, Glasgow Kiss) are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop. With so many closers bunched together and limited early pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for those who can get competitive early and sustain their effort. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can avoid the late traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Valkyrie Storm or Gwen's Girl can track Inferno without getting caught up in the closing cavalry charge.
scenarios.body: The strong recent form of Valkyrie Storm (win last time) and her prominent style perfectly suits this tactical setup. Gwen's Girl also benefits from being able to position handy while the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno can control fractions and the hold-up horses don't get clear runs in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, Inferno sets sensible fractions and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges from a field that may struggle for racing room. The 1m4f distance suits his stamina-oriented pedigree background.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and one of the closers gets a dream run through.
scenarios.body: Quick Turn showed winning form last time and could benefit if the early pace quickens beyond comfort zones. The traffic concerns remain significant with so many hold-up horses targeting similar racing positions late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Layoff Success
scenarios.trigger: If Bosom Pals can overcome the 254-day absence and reproduce his winning form from earlier this year.
scenarios.body: The extended break is a major concern but his win earlier this year over course and distance cannot be ignored completely. Tom Dascombe has a 1/7 record in the past 14 days suggesting selective placement.

watchPoints.text: Inferno must be watched for early pace judgment - if he goes too fast early he'll be vulnerable to the late closers who will get better racing conditions.
Quick Turn and the other hold-up horses for traffic problems - with so many closers bunched together, several will get poor runs and excuses.
Bosom Pals for fitness after 254-day layoff - any signs of rustiness or blowing up will confirm the extended break is too much to overcome.
Valkyrie Storm for her jumping and early positioning - she needs to track the pace smoothly to capitalize on her tactical advantage.
The pace development in the middle sections - if it becomes stop-start it will suit the hold-up horses more than current race shape suggests.

races.paceDynamic: Degale and Port Erin will clash for the early lead, with Degale likely to establish control given his more recent front-running form. Aspull, Orangesandlemons and Barry's Boy will track just behind this pace, creating a solid early gallop over the extended 1m2f trip. The presence of two genuine pace-setters should create an honest tempo that will set up the race for the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks in the final 2-3 furlongs. This pace shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can exploit the inevitable weakening of the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Degale and Port Erin duel early and weaken the pace-setters
scenarios.body: The honest early gallop sets up perfectly for the closers to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Principality, Helm Rock, Intrusively and Winston's Warrior all possess the tactical speed to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the perfect stalking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: Aspull or Orangesandlemons could time their move perfectly to catch the leaders and hold off the closers. Their racing position allows them to respond to moves while avoiding the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse suits closer
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The front-runners completely empty their tanks, allowing a strong closer like Youarenotforgiven or Asteverdi to power through late. This would require the leaders to go harder than expected in the opening half-mile.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Degale or Port Erin can establish an uncontested lead without pace pressure
scenarios.body: The leader could dictate moderate fractions and kick clear when challenged, negating the closers' advantages. This requires the other pace-setter to settle or miss the break entirely.
